description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams, which extends a base filter parameters class. It manages search filter parameters for 'likes' on comments within the Buzz module of the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling comment ID filtering and sort field defaults.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class encapsulating filter parameters for searching likes on comments, including allowed sort fields and comment ID filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object with default sort field 'commentLike.likedAtUtc'.

methods.name: getCommentId
methods.description: Retrieves the current comment ID filter value.

methods.name: setCommentId
methods.description: Sets the comment ID filter value.
